propositions: Prior plan-review findings re-qualified for recall every round even after plan edits addressed them, causing verbatim replay of findings with empty evidence across consecutive review cycles without convergence.

Recalled findings were injected with hardcoded empty evidence and blank impact, then re-verified and re-persisted indistinguishably from fresh findings, re-qualifying them for recall on the next round (ratchet mechanism).

Pass-2 backstop did not eliminate stale recalled findings because injected candidates carried no grounding, so the verifier confirmed bare assertions instead of testing evidence against current plan text.

v2 sidecars persist evidence losslessly but prior_concerns never read it; carry persisted evidence and impact into concerns and inject them so Pass-2 re-grounds claims against current plan instead of rubber-stamping ungrounded assertions.
Exclude findings with no persisted grounding evidence from recall eligibility since they cannot be re-grounded; this breaks the ratchet and works on already-written sidecars without migration.

Suppress recall when prior sidecar material_fingerprint differs from current material_fingerprint, because on changed material a finder's silence indicates the edit resolved the finding rather than a miss.
